Welcome to saber ! How may I help you?

- **Input Details:** No specific fields are required for reprinting the ambulance charge; the process involves accessing the reprint function directly.

- **Process Steps:**
  1. Click the ‘Reprint’ button to generate the reprint of the bill.
  2. Alternatively, you can use the keyboard shortcut F12 or Alt + R to reprint the bill.
  3. Upon clicking the ‘Reprint’ button, the previously billed details will load into a pop-up screen.
  4. From the pop-up screen, choose to print the service bill, deduct bill, or take a thermal print by clicking the respective print button.

- **Images:** [Screenshot of the Reprint pop-up screen with options](#) (Note: Please replace with actual image link if available)

- **Outcome:** The ambulance charge bill will be reprinted as per your selection, allowing you to obtain the necessary documentation.
